subject.title: fix(browser): bound Chrome launch stderr diagnostics

question: Should this PR be treated as proof-sufficient for head 40b680f7 even though the posted real managed-Chrome proof names 7fe9bfcf, or should the author add a current-head proof note?
rationale: The latest maintainer commits changed the shared helper used by the proved path after the PR body’s real Chrome proof was recorded, so automation should not silently treat stale proof as current-head proof.

options.title: Request Current-Head Proof
options.body: Ask for a short rerun or proof note against 40b680f7 before merge so the real behavior evidence matches the reviewed code.

options.title: Accept Prior Proof For Refactor
options.body: A maintainer can decide the two latest helper refactor commits are narrow enough that the earlier real Chrome proof plus focused tests cover the final head.

recommendation.title: Request Current-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a short rerun or proof note against 40b680f7 before merge so the real behavior evidence matches the reviewed code.
